description: A generic asset declaration, appraisal summary, or itemized personal-property statement for assets that do not fit a standard category, such as collectibles, jewelry, or equipment. Used to verify miscellaneous asset value.

owner_name.instruction: The full name of the person who owns the declared assets.

appraiser_or_preparer_name.instruction: The name of the appraiser, assessor, or preparer of the statement, if shown.

asset_descriptions.instruction: The description of each individual itemized asset, such as its name, brand, model, or identifying details. Return one entry per asset item listed, in the same order as asset_categories and estimated_values.

asset_categories.instruction: Classify each individual asset item into one of: Collectibles, Jewelry, Electronics, Equipment, Furniture, or Other, based on its description, even if no category label is printed on the document. Return one entry per asset item listed, in the same order as asset_descriptions and estimated_values.

estimated_values.instruction: The estimated or appraised value of each individual asset item. Return one entry per asset item listed, in the same order as asset_descriptions and asset_categories.

total_estimated_value.instruction: The total estimated value of all declared assets on the statement.

statement_date.instruction: The date of the statement or appraisal. YYYY-MM-DD format.
